players.name: Josh Allen
players.summary: Bills head coach Joe Brady downplayed any concern about Allen's health after the quarterback took a hit to his knee area during the fourth quarter of Sunday's 24-16 win over the Chargers, Alex Brasky of SI.com and Alec White of the team's official site report. "We're gonna have to see how [Allen] progresses these next couple days," Brady said. "Josh is always a little [sore] after the game."

players.name: Xavier Legette
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Jalen Coker
players.summary: Coker has been diagnosed with a minor quadriceps strain and could be available to play in next Sunday's game against the Lions, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Jonathon Brooks
players.summary: Brooks is expected to undergo surgery Wednesday to repair a core-muscle injury and is likely to miss at least six weeks, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Caleb Williams
players.summary: doubtful

players.name: Colbie Young
players.summary: Young (knee) is not expected to play in Week 4 against the Jaguars, Jay Morrison of SI.com reports.

players.name: Andrei Iosivas
players.summary: The Bengals placed Iosivas (thumb) on injured reserve Saturday.

players.name: Tylan Wallace
players.summary: Wallace (knee) did not participate in the Browns' estimated practice Monday, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

players.name: Marvin Mims Jr.
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Jonah Coleman
players.summary: Coleman (ankle) is being placed on injured reserve Saturday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: Jayden Reed
players.summary: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Monday that he still has no update regarding how long Reed (neck) will be sidelined, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Nico Collins
players.summary: Head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that he's "hopeful" to have Collins available for the Texans' Week 4 game against the Cowboys, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

players.name: Ashton Dulin
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.summary: Colts head coach Shane Steichen reiterated Monday that Pierce didn't undergo surgery on his left heel and is continuing to rehab the injury, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Aidan O'Connell
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Jack Bech
players.summary: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak confirmed Monday that Bech (forearm) is slated to be placed on injured reserve, Paul Gutierrez of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Charlie Kolar
players.summary: doubtful

players.name: Colby Parkinson
players.summary: Head coach Sean McVay said Monday that Parkinson is day-to-day due to an AC joint sprain in his shoulder that he picked up during the Rams' 30-26 loss to the Broncos on Sunday, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

players.name: Terrance Ferguson
players.summary: Coach Sean McVay said Monday that Ferguson "likely" will be sidelined for Sunday's game in Philadelphia, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.summary: Head coach Sean McVay said Monday that the Rams are "hopeful" Nacua (hip) will return to action for Sunday's game at Philadelphia, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

players.name: Ronnie Rivers
players.summary: The Rams placed Rivers (calf) on their injured reserve list Wednesday.

players.name: De'Von Achane
players.summary: The Dolphins placed Achane (knee) on injured reserve Monday.

players.name: Caleb Douglas
players.summary: Dolphins head coach Jeff Hafley said Douglas (ankle) is day-to-day and could practice Wednesday, Travis Wingfield of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Jaylen Wright
players.summary: Head coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that he considers Wright (stinger/foot) to be "day-to-day," Joe Schad of The Palm Beach Post reports.

players.name: Justin Jefferson
players.summary: Jefferson was diagnosed Monday with a sprained left ankle following an MRI, and the Vikings are hopeful that he'll be able to play Sunday versus the Dolphins, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Josh Oliver
players.summary: Oliver was diagnosed with a torn biceps following an MRI on Monday and is expected to undergo surgery in the coming days, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Eli Raridon
players.summary: questionable

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.summary: Brown was spotted Monday in the Patriots' locker room walking without a limp and wearing a small wrap on his injured right ankle, Taylor Kyles of CLNSMedia.com reports.

players.name: Barion Brown
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
players.summary: Saints head coach Kellen Moore said that Etienne will have some "time lost" due to the hamstring injury he sustained in Sunday's 35-27 loss to the Raiders, Mike Triplett of NewOrleans.Football reports.

players.name: Jaxson Dart
players.summary: The Giants officially placed Dart (knee) on injured reserve Thursday, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Mason Taylor
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Adonai Mitchell
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Kene Nwangwu
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Breece Hall
players.summary: Hall is considered week-to-week after an MRI on Monday revealed that his thigh injury isn't significant as feared, Ian Rapoport and Adam Schefter of ESPN report.

players.name: Arian Smith
players.summary: Smith (knee) underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn ACL and will miss the rest of the season, Antwan V. Staley of the New York Daily News reports.

players.name: Dallas Goedert
players.summary: doubtful

players.name: Hollywood Brown
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Tanner McKee
players.summary: McKee (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the team's emergency third quarterback Monday night against the Bears.

players.name: Cole Payton
players.summary: inactive

players.name: Rico Dowdle
players.summary: Dowdle (toe) wasn't present for Monday's walkthrough practice, Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.summary: Evans is considered day-to-day after sustaining a rib strain during Sunday's 36-30 win over the Cardinals, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Demarcus Robinson
players.summary: The 49ers placed Robinson (ankle) on injured reserve Saturday.

players.name: Zach Charbonnet
players.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that Charbonnet (knee) returning to practice next week is potentially "on the table," Corbin Smith of SI.com reports.

players.name: Jalen McMillan
players.summary: McMillan has been diagnosed with a PCL sprain in his left knee, Jenna Laine of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Baker Mayfield
players.summary: Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles said Monday that Mayfield (thumb) is expected to miss three weeks, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: Jayden Daniels
players.summary: Daniels will avoid a procedure on his dislocated left elbow for the time being, but Adam Schefter of ESPN reports that the quarterback could undergo surgery after the season.

players.name: Chig Okonkwo
players.summary: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said that Okonkwo (hamstring) will make the trip to London and will practice in some capacity leading up to Sunday's game against the Colts, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.
